title: The People Seal the Covenant

questions.question: Who was the first to seal the covenant?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:1 (ESV): "On the seals are the names of Nehemiah the governor..."

questions.question: What did the people enter into?
options: A curse and an oath to walk in God's Law
questions.correctAnswer: A curse and an oath to walk in God's Law
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:29 (ESV): "...enter into a curse and an oath to walk in God's Law..."

questions.question: What did they promise regarding marriage?
options: We will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons
We will marry whoever we want
questions.correctAnswer: We will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:30 (ESV): "We will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons."

questions.question: What did they promise regarding the Sabbath?
options: We will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day
questions.correctAnswer: We will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:31 (ESV): "...we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day..."

questions.question: What were they to forego in the seventh year?
options: The crops and the exaction of every debt
questions.correctAnswer: The crops and the exaction of every debt
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:31 (ESV): "...And we will forego the crops of the seventh year and the exaction of every debt."

questions.question: amount did they obligate themselves to give yearly for the service of the house of God?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:32 (ESV): "...to give one-third of a shekel yearly for the service of the house of our God..."

questions.question: How was the wood offering determined?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:34 (ESV): "We cast lots... concerning the wood offering..."

questions.question: What were they to bring to the priests?
options: The firstfruits of the ground and of every tree
questions.correctAnswer: The firstfruits of the ground and of every tree
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:35 (ESV): "We obligate ourselves to bring the firstfruits of our ground and the firstfruits of all fruit of every tree..."

questions.question: To whom does the tithe belong?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:37 (ESV): "...and the tithes of our ground to the Levites..."

questions.question: What final promise summarizes their commitment to the temple?
options: We will not neglect the house of our God
questions.correctAnswer: We will not neglect the house of our God
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:39 (ESV): "...We will not neglect the house of our God."

questions.question: Who was to be with the Levites when they received the tithes?
options: A priest, the son of Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: A priest, the son of Aaron
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:38 (ESV): "And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites when the Levites receive the tithes..."

questions.question: Where were the Levites to bring the tithe of the tithes?
options: To the house of our God, to the chambers, to the storehouse
questions.correctAnswer: To the house of our God, to the chambers, to the storehouse
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:38 (ESV): "...bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the chambers, to the storehouse."

questions.question: Who else joined the leaders in the oath?
options: Their wives, their sons, their daughters, all who have knowledge and understanding
questions.correctAnswer: Their wives, their sons, their daughters, all who have knowledge and understanding
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:28 (ESV): "...their wives, their sons, their daughters, all who have knowledge and understanding..."

questions.question: What was the bread of the Presence mentioned in the obligations?
options: Bread set out in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Bread set out in the temple
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:33 (ESV): "for the bread of the Presence..."

questions.question: Why were the firstborn of sons and cattle brought to the house of God?
options: As written in the Law, to the priests who minister
questions.correctAnswer: As written in the Law, to the priests who minister
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:36 (ESV): "also to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God, the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as it is written in the Law..."

key_verse_text: For the people of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the contribution of grain, wine, and oil to the chambers, where the vessels of the sanctuary are, as well as the priests who minister, and the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not neglect the house of our God.
